title.narrative: INTERVENTIONS TO PREVENT TEENAGE PREGNANCIES AND MITIGATE THE NEGATIVE EFFECTS ON GIRLS PRIMARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION IN NAROK COUNTY, KENYA

description.narrative: The project will be carried out in Narok County among selected schools Learners (Girls and Boys), teachers, head teachers, local administrators, religious leaders, women and youth, through criteria that will be set out by the implementing team. The purpose of this project will be to prevent teenage pregnancy and mitigate its effects on girls primary and secondary education in Narok County. This is a key step towards reducing cases of early pregnancies and facilitating enrolment and completion rates of girls affected by teenage pregnancies in the County. The specific objectives include: building the capacity of teachers, parents and key stakeholders; enhance the exposure, knowledge and experiences of higher learning and career development opportunities ;create a learner friendly and supportive environment in schools to support girls at risk of early pregnancy; enhance the knowledge base and opportunities for harmonized support for the girls primary and secondary education in Narok County, Kenya. Main activities will entail: training teachers, Members of Parents association and opinion leaders in the Community on prevention of teenage pregnancies and mitigation the effects of the pregnancies; organizing an exposure trip for selected teachers and learners to the local university to facilitate expanded world view of the learners; establishing Family Units to facilitate mentorship, development of psychosocial competencies/life skills and homegrown solution to address factors leading to teenage pregnancies; organizing a meeting for actors on girls education in Narok County to enhance collaboration and coordination. The expected outcome will be: increased awareness and capacity to prevent and address effects of teenage pregnancies on girls primary and secondary education hence enhance mitigation measures; increased motivation to learn and complete schooling; enhanced capacity on mental health & psychosocial support , Guidance and Counselling, life skills, Value Based Education, mentorship, peer support and school- based sustainable income generating activities; enhanced coordination among actors on prevention and management of teenage pregnancies for girls in primary and secondary education. It is expected that there will be enhanced coordination among actors for girls’ education and mitigate the negative effects of issues that hinder girls primary and secondary education.
